overview.label: Commerce Council Overview
overview.content:
# Commerce Council Overview

The Commerce Council plans product-based businesses such as Etsy, print-on-demand, Shopify stores, ebooks, KDP, Gumroad, Payhip, and digital products.

## Boundary

This council plans and prepares commerce operations only. Raphael does not create stores, upload products, spend money, log in to platforms, publish listings, or perform external platform actions.

## Specialist Agents

- Store Manager Agent
- Product Researcher Agent
- Trend Analyst Agent
- Listing Writer Agent
- SEO Specialist Agent
- Customer Support Agent
- Digital Product Agent
- POD Designer Agent

## Linked Studio

- [[POD Design Studio/POD Design Studio Overview|POD Design Studio]] — local concepts, design prompts, generation requests, reviews, listing drafts, and export-package preparation.
- [[../Asset & Brand Library/Asset Library Overview|Asset & Brand Library]] — reusable POD styles, listing structures, mockup systems, prompts, and approved asset references.

strategy.label: Commerce Strategy
strategy.content:
# Commerce Strategy

## Strategy

- Validate niches before creating products.
- Create product and listing plans before platform work.
- Keep IP, trademark, copyright, and platform-policy risks visible.
- Use search requests for current platform rules, trend data, or pricing facts.
- Convert promising ideas into blueprints, simulations, and resource plans before execution.
